messages.subject: HSMM package
parts:
In HSMM package, there is an interface function :
hsmm(x,
od,
od.par,
rd = "nonp",
rd.par = list(np = matrix(0.1, nrow = 10, ncol = 2)),
pi.par = c(0.5, 0.5),
tpm.par = matrix(c(0, 1, 1, 0), 2),
M = NA,
Q.max = 500,
epsilon = 1e-08,
censoring = 1,
prt = TRUE,
detailed = FALSE,
r.lim = c(0.01, 100),
p.log.lim = c(0.001, 0.999),
nu.lim = c(0.01, 100))

parameter x : the observations as a vector of length T
Could the elements in this vector be also vectors, which comprise of
the observed features? In another word, can each observed element be a
multi-dimension one?
thanks alot!
